##Loading the R packages





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, sf, tmap, httr)
```
:::





## Importing ACRA data





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
folder_path <- "data/aspatial/acra"
file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path,
                        pattern = "^ACRA*.*\\.csv$",
                        full.names = TRUE)

acra_data <- file_list %>%
  map_dfr(read_csv)
```
:::





## Saving ACRA data





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
write_rds(acra_data,
          "data/rds/acra_data.rds")
```
:::





## Tidying ACRA data

56111 is the type of business selected.





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
biz_56111 <- acra_data %>%
  select(1:24) %>%
  filter(primary_ssic_code == 56111) %>%
  rename(date = registration_incorporation_date) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date),
         YEAR = year(date),
         MONTH_NUM = month(date),
         MONTH_ABBR = month(date,
                            label = TRUE,
                            abbr = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(
    postal_code = str_pad(postal_code, 
    width = 6, side = "left", pad = "0")) %>% 
           filter(YEAR == 2025)
```
:::
